title: Neon Turtle Crystal Orb
description: A glowing crystal sphere mounted on a metallic stand contains a large central sea turtle with a bright cyan shell and golden eye, surrounded by smaller turtles and a luminous purple-pink female figure with long flowing hair reaching upward. Electric blue and magenta energy lines radiate between the figures against a dark abstract background.
prompt: A mystical glowing crystal sphere on a metallic stand, inside which floats a large detailed sea turtle with a brightly glowing cyan and green shell and golden eye. A translucent woman with long flowing purple hair reaches upward, connected by electric blue and magenta energy tendrils to the turtle and several smaller glowing sea turtles surrounding it. Dark background with purple ambient light, luminous fantasy style, intricate line work and vibrant neon bioluminescence.
